snippet.title: Luminas: Parasite Reign - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
⚔️ Face the Parasites. Defy the Bosses.

Enter Luminas: Parasite Reign, a 3D party based roguelite. Create your party of Luminas and unleash devastating spells against endless waves of Parasites.
Build powerful party synergies and different playstyles, unlock evolving skill trees, and survive through procedurally generated maps filled with unique enemies and bosses.

🔥 Features:
 • 8 playable Luminas, each with their own playstyle and evolutions
 • Dynamic maps with different biomes/mechanics
 • Skilltrees, Equipments, and more meta progression challenges
 • Fast-paced, chaotic combat built in Unreal Engine 5

💥 Available Now on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3724100/Luminas_Parasite_Reign/

💬 Join Our Discord for Updates & Community Events:
